en.topic_title: Hong Kong authorities decline to comment on report that US fighter jet parts diverted to city
en.topic_summary:
Hong Kong authorities have declined to comment on a report that parts for F-35 fighter jets, a classified US aircraft targeted by Chinese intelligence, were diverted to the city.



F-35B Lightning II aircraft at Eielson Air Force Base, Alaska. Photo: F-35 Lightning II Joint Program Office﻿, via Facebook.



Media outlet Politico reported last week that a shipment of US-bound F-35 parts being flown from Australia this summer ended up in Hong Kong, citing anonymous sources.
